question: Why is formal writing used in healthcare practice instead of casual text messages?

options.A: It is always read aloud to the entire hospital board
options.B: It is only used for personal leave requests
options.C: It must be handwritten using blue ink only
options.D: It creates a permanent, legally binding record

explanation: Official letters serve as documented evidence of professional transactions and decisions which can be referenced legally if needed. [learn more](BMP115_U4_T9#BMP115_U4_T9_h1)

question: Why is it important for a midwife in Nigeria to learn formal letter writing?

options.A: To successfully communicate with regulatory bodies like the NMCN
options.B: To avoid paying professional union dues
options.C: To diagnose complex obstetric complications faster
options.D: To replace all verbal handovers during ward shifts

explanation: Midwives frequently need to interact with administrative institutions, ministries, and councils where formal writing is mandatory. [learn more](BMP115_U4_T9#BMP115_U4_T9_h1)

question: What are the three core pillars of official letter writing?
explanation: These three principles ensure that professional correspondence is easy to read, direct, and respectful. [learn more](BMP115_U4_T9#BMP115_U4_T9_h2)

question: What happens when an official letter sent to a Nigerian health ministry contains too much rambling text?

options.A: It results in an immediate promotion for the writer
options.B: It gets automatically published in the national newspapers
options.C: It is often delayed or ignored entirely by busy administrators
options.D: It is sent back with a financial cash reward

explanation: Administrators handle a high volume of paperwork and tend to sideline poorly structured or overly wordy correspondence. [learn more](BMP115_U4_T9#BMP115_U4_T9_h2)

question: When should you use 'Yours faithfully' as a closing in an official letter?

options.A: When signing off on a patient's prescription chart
options.B: When you want to show extreme anger in a grievance
options.C: When addressing someone whose name you do not know
options.D: When writing to a close personal friend in the ward

explanation: By convention, 'Yours faithfully' pairs with 'Dear Sir/Madam', while 'Yours sincerely' pairs with a named recipient. [learn more](BMP115_U4_T9#BMP115_U4_T9_h3)

question: What is the main purpose of including a Subject line (RE) in an official healthcare letter?

options.A: To give the reader a quick summary of what the letter is about
options.B: To replace the need for writing a signature at the end
options.C: To provide a secret password for opening the document
options.D: To indicate the exact financial cost of the request

explanation: The subject line lets the administrator know the core topic immediately before reading the full text. [learn more](BMP115_U4_T9#BMP115_U4_T9_h3)

question: Why must a midwife avoid slang in an official administrative letter?

options.A: Because hospital computers cannot process local words
options.B: Because informal words make the letter print out too slowly
options.C: Because only doctors are allowed to use informal language
options.D: Because formal letters require an objective and professional register

explanation: Professional documents must maintain a serious, standardized tone suitable for legal and administrative review. [learn more](BMP115_U4_T9#BMP115_U4_T9_h4)

question: Which of the following describes the correct tone for nursing administration correspondence?
explanation: An objective and formal tone ensures that professional issues are addressed with the seriousness they deserve. [learn more](BMP115_U4_T9#BMP115_U4_T9_h4)

question: What is the primary purpose of a query response letter in nursing practice?

options.A: To request a promotion to a senior matron position
options.B: To apply for annual vacation leave
options.C: To ask for financial donations from the hospital board
options.D: To provide a formal explanation regarding a clinical incident

explanation: A query response allows a nurse or midwife to address administrative or clinical concerns raised by management. [learn more](BMP115_U4_T9#BMP115_U4_T9_h5)

question: If a midwife wishes to leave her current employment, what must she include in her letter of resignation?

options.A: An insult directed at the chief medical director
options.B: A request for a double salary payout
options.C: Adherence to the notice period specified in her contract
options.D: A detailed list of every patient she has ever cared for

explanation: Resignation letters must respect contractual notice terms to ensure a smooth handover and clear employment records. [learn more](BMP115_U4_T9#BMP115_U4_T9_h5)

question: Why is it a mistake to skip your immediate supervisor when submitting an official letter to management?

options.A: It automatically guarantees your request will be granted
options.B: It breaks administrative protocol and causes workplace friction
options.C: It makes the letter arrive at its destination faster
options.D: It stops the printing machine from working

explanation: Proper channeling ensures that all tiers of leadership are aware of administrative matters concerning their staff. [learn more](BMP115_U4_T9#BMP115_U4_T9_h6)

question: Which of the following is NOT a good practice when finalizing an official letter?

options.A: Proofreading the text at least twice before printing
options.B: Checking that all mentioned attachments are included
options.C: Ensuring proper administrative channels are followed
options.D: Submitting the draft without proofreading or checking names

explanation: Failing to check names and proofread introduces errors that damage your professional credibility. [learn more](BMP115_U4_T9#BMP115_U4_T9_h6)
